description: This file defines a mock class 'IarmBusImplMock' for testing purposes, which inherits from 'IarmBusImpl'. It includes mock method definitions for all IARM bus related functions and sets default behaviors for them using Google Mock. The file is intended for unit testing the IARM bus interface within the project.
